unlock_condition: Real count magnitudes remain locked. Unlock requires a new pre-outcome hierarchical integrated-recovery receipt (PAPER2_INTEGRATED_HIERARCHICAL_RECOVERY_RESULT_V2.json) with decision.counts_may_be_opened=true, plus completion of the frozen integrated observation-source sensitivity recovery gate.

observation_pipeline.image_offset: One shared image-minus-direct offset. Within each site x species x season containing both known families, compute mean(log1p(image)) - mean(log1p(direct)); delta_image is the unweighted mean across mixed groups.
observation_pipeline.accuracy_scales: After subtracting the shared image offset, estimate sigma_1 and sigma_2_5 by pooling within-site x species x season residual sums of squares only among repeated records in the same collapsed accuracy group.
observation_pipeline.unknown_vantage: retain with no method mean shift; use its recorded accuracy class for observation precision; mandatory exclusion sensitivity
observation_pipeline.same_season_collapse: inverse estimated observation-variance weighted mean of method-corrected log1p counts
observation_pipeline.date_matched_method_sensitivity: secondary: recompute the image-direct offset from exact-date pairs and <=14-day pairs separately when estimable; do not replace the primary same-season offset based on which is more favorable

primary_process.failed_model: Gate 2E-C v1 used method-corrected same-season collapse followed by adjacent differences, free site-specific loading recovery, and a second-stage trait regression.
primary_process.failure_reason: Under the frozen synthetic count/observation process, the observation nuisance parameters remained recoverable but shared forcing/site loadings and trait effects were not reliably recovered across species.
primary_process.replacement_requirement: Gate 2E-C v2 must propagate observation uncertainty and estimate the trait-loading relationship jointly/hierarchically rather than treating noisy site loadings as observed responses.
retained_identification: mean annual forcing = 0 within each forcing group
mean site loading = 1 within each forcing group

site_trait_models.standardization: A, H and R use the already-frozen transforms and are standardized within each species analysis frame.
main_effect_order: hierarchical loading fit with A only
hierarchical loading fit with H only
hierarchical loading fit with R only
site_trait_models.crossover: hierarchical loading fit with A + H + A:H

crossover_definition.low_area_H_slope: beta_H - beta_AH; crossover pattern requires >= 0 at A=-1 SD
crossover_definition.high_area_H_slope: beta_H + beta_AH; crossover pattern requires < 0 at A=+1 SD
crossover_definition.wording_rule: Do not call the result an option-fragmentation crossover unless all three directional conditions hold.

site_trait_models.secondary_combined: hierarchical loading fit with A + H + R + A:H; secondary synthesis only
site_trait_models.mean_growth_secondary: mu_i is analyzed against the same staged trait models to distinguish response filtering from ordinary habitat-quality associations.

hierarchical_engine_alignment.A_main: Use the same hierarchical loading engine with loading model lambda_i = 1 + gamma_A * A_centered_within_forcing_group + b_i.
hierarchical_engine_alignment.H_main: Use the same hierarchical loading engine with loading model lambda_i = 1 + gamma_H * H_centered_within_forcing_group + b_i.
hierarchical_engine_alignment.R_main: Use the same hierarchical loading engine with loading model lambda_i = 1 + gamma_R * R_centered_within_forcing_group + b_i. R is not inferred by regressing a separately estimated lambda_hat after fitting.
hierarchical_engine_alignment.crossover: Use the V2 hierarchical loading model with forcing-group-centered A, H and A:H jointly plus residual b_i.
hierarchical_engine_alignment.secondary_combined: Only after the four staged fits, use one hierarchical loading engine with centered A, H, R and A:H jointly as a secondary synthesis.
hierarchical_engine_alignment.reason: This keeps real-outcome estimation aligned with the estimator that passed/fails pre-outcome recovery; no primary site-trait effect is estimated from noisy post-hoc lambda_hat.

inference.primary_crossover_statistic: beta_AH from the dedicated crossover model

directional_permutation.scheme: permute lambda within the frozen forcing groups of each species; refit the identical crossover model; p = (1 + number beta_AH_perm <= beta_AH_observed)/(B+1)
directional_permutation.reason: tests the frozen site-trait association while preserving forcing-group structure

effect_reporting: beta_AH and its within-group permutation distribution
low-area and high-area H marginal slopes
A, H and R single-predictor coefficients
number of units and forcing groups
lambda distribution and fitted forcing summaries
inference.cross_species_rule: Species-specific results remain primary. Generality is described from direction and effect-size concordance across the three species; no post-outcome species subset may be chosen.

mandatory_sensitivities.forcing_scale: Refit every species with one species-wide forcing using predictor-complete units ADPE=41, CHPE=34, GEPE=29. If the focal trait direction or crossover classification materially changes, report forcing-scale dependence.
mandatory_sensitivities.exclude_unknown_vantage: Remove the 62 unknown-vantage records and rerun the full pipeline with the same estimators.
mandatory_sensitivities.ground_only: Use ground observations only for the demographic reconstruction; report as robustness/coverage sensitivity and never substitute it for the primary result because it is stronger.
mandatory_sensitivities.observation_timing: report exact-date and <=14-day image-offset sensitivity when estimable
mandatory_sensitivities.shannon: Tier 2 Shannon remains sensitivity-only as previously frozen
mandatory_sensitivities.radii: 1 km and 5 km trait versions remain sensitivity-only; they cannot replace the 2 km primary scale

process_variance_claim.rule: Only test/interpret decoupling-with-local-instability if the separate pre-outcome process-variance recovery gate passes. Otherwise omit/demote this claim without altering lambda/AxH inference.

terminal_rules: No new primary site trait, radius, year subset, geographic partition, transform or interaction may be introduced after counts are opened.
Do not change the retained forcing scale because the ecological coefficient is weak or opposite-signed.
Do not replace the shared image offset with species-specific offsets in the primary model.
A null or opposite A x H result is a valid falsification and does not trigger model searching.
The latent shared factor is not named as a specific climate mechanism without an independent environmental attribution analysis.
Results from superseded PR #65 are not consulted to alter this contract.
Do not relax Gate 2E-C v1 simulation truths or recovery thresholds to unlock real counts; estimator redesign must be validated against the same frozen stress test.

required_pre_outcome_gates.integrated_v2: required; one-stage/hierarchical process-observation estimator must pass without relaxing v1 simulation truths or recovery thresholds
required_pre_outcome_gates.process_variance: optional for count opening but required before any decoupling-with-local-instability claim
